title: earthtojake/text-to-cad gives coding agents CAD tools
friendlyTitle: Give an AI coding agent tools for making CAD designs
summary: text-to-cad is a 16,800-star project that equips coding agents with skills and plugins for generating and editing CAD models. It supports several agent environments and has been shipping frequent releases, including recent improvements to STEP-file handling.
friendlySummary: text-to-cad helps AI agents create and change 3D engineering models from written instructions. It works with several popular coding-agent systems.
whyItMatters: Makers, engineers and product teams can use it to turn written design instructions into editable CAD work rather than static images. Generated geometry still needs dimensional, mechanical and safety review before fabrication.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can speed up early design work and repeated edits. Always check measurements and engineering safety before making a physical object.
